reuse.why: Ignores the existing notes table (server/notes/app.ts, where group notes are saved by id) and the #shared/tags helpers, adding a new category_groups.notes column and a hand-written SQL regex instead.

duplication.why: The tag condition is written once, inside the shared getMonthActionCategories query, with no copied logic.

placement.why: The filter sits in the right selection helper, but the data it reads is placed in a new schema column via a migration, a different layer from where the tree keeps notes.

scope.why: A database migration and a DbCategoryGroup type change are added for a behaviour that only needed to read existing notes.

maintainability.why: Introduces a parallel storage for group notes that the notes UI never writes to, and leaves copyPreviousMonth applying the old exclusions on its own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: migrations/1791838388703_add_category_group_notes.sql and getMonthActionCategories read category_groups.notes instead of the notes table used by notes-get/notes-save.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the problem is a parallel data source rather than copied code.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is added only to getMonthActionCategories; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline hidden/income checks from getBudgetData and never applies it.
